description.value: Ajisai 2 Go is the grab-and-go counter of the well-regarded Sushi Bar Ajisai, situated just steps from the original restaurant on West 42nd Avenue in Vancouver's Kerrisdale neighbourhood. It offers freshly made sushi rolls, bento boxes, donburi, onigiri, and Japanese imported snacks and drinks — all ready to take without a wait. Exclusive items like Mini Chirashi, Aburi Salmon Battera, and Hosomaki Trio make it a more distinctive quick stop than a typical convenience outlet.

bike_parking_detail: 9 racks within 100m: rack (5 spaces) at 6m; rack (5 spaces, covered) at 17m; rack (3 spaces, covered) at 31m; rack (3 spaces) at 51m; rack (4 spaces) at 70m; rack (6 spaces) at 81m; stands (2 spaces) at 90m; stands (2 spaces) at 93m; stands (2 spaces) at 98m. Total: 32 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at sushibarajisai.com/ajisai-2-go confirms Ajisai 2 Go as a grab-and-go sushi counter at 2087 W.42nd Ave, Vancouver, operating under the Sushi Bar Ajisai umbrella, with a full menu of ready-made sushi, bento boxes, donburi, onigiri, and Japanese imported snacks and drinks. Vegetarian options are explicitly flagged with (V) across multiple menu items including Edamame, Spinach Gomaae, Vegetable Chirashi, Inari nigiri, and others. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM had no phone number; the phone (604)-266-1428 is sourced from the website but is listed there as the Sushi Bar Ajisai parent restaurant number (2081 W.42nd Ave), used for all takeout orders across both locations.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating grab-and-go sushi business with a confirmed address, live website, and a 2026 copyright date — a solid quick-stop option for touring cyclists.

Packed lunches.detail: Pre-packaged bento boxes available: 'Sushi Bento' (5 kinds of nigiri, tobiko, cucumber roll and tuna roll) and '2 Go Bento' (BBQ Salmon, karaage and potato croquette with pickles and rice)

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Multiple items explicitly marked (V) on the menu: Edamame, Moro Kyu, Spinach Gomaae, Spinach Ohitashi, Wakame Sunomono, Hiya Yakko (cold tofu), Tamago nigiri, Inari nigiri, Vegetable Chirashi, Green Salad
